notes: (1) integrity_scan.py could not be run because this evaluation allowed only the aggregation and related_search.py scripts; I did a manual regex search of the paper text instead and no reviewer-directed text was found, so reviewers read the original text, not a redacted copy. (2) The skill's Phase 0 says to run integrity_scan; the task rules conflict with that. (3) related_search.py: the 4-concept-word limit treats hyphenated terms and 'RL' as words, so several queries were refused; the 'benchmarks' command returned no benchmarks for this text, so only MathVista was scouted. The script output for Vision-R1 includes an 'Accepted to ICLR 2026' comment, i.e. outcome information about a different paper; I did not use it. (4) The EIC aggregation step requires the same pipeline run twice; with an empty da_critical list the before/after runs differ only by the eic_weight values. The before run flagged a composite band (2) different from the rating-based starting point (3), and the weighted run flipped to band 3 at 50.2 (0.2 above the edge): the 'within 2 points of band edge' rule handled it, but it shows how near-boundary results swing. (5) Pool-position guidance (accepted paper 62-72, rejected 42-54) combined with the 'Overall 4 needs pool >= 65' rule left no room for the Perspective reviewer, nominally the most positive, to give 4, which compresses the panel to all 3s; the reports follow the rule rather than the persona tone. (6) Reviewer independence is simulated in one shared context. (7) Figures were unavailable, so Fig. 1/4/5 claims (ablations, entropy curves, G=20 vs G=5) are judged from captions and prose only.
